who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), main agent, lane proofs-1113
what: I merged #2164 with main five commits past the head I had smoked. The round ended with `main past landing: 0`; my merge command fetched again, printed `main past landing: 5` and went on to `gh pr merge --admin --match-head-commit` in the same `&&` chain, because the line that printed the count did not test it. Main`s tree after the merge (27041e05d1) was not the smoked tree (21e57da4b5): another lane`s merge (#2163, the profile history, 12 files of blaze-profile) had landed in the minutes the pull request took to open. I then built and smoked main`s exact tree on blaze-vm: `verdict ok`.
cost: a merge on a tree nobody had smoked, for about ten minutes; six minutes of build and smoke after it
cause: the check that main had not moved was a line that printed a number, and the pin (`--match-head-commit`) is of the branch`s head, not of the base it merges into
whys: main got a tree that was not smoked
the merge ran though main had moved
the count was printed and not tested
the merge step was a chain I typed each round, not a tool that refuses
GitHub`s pin names the head only, so the base can move between any check and the merge
class: a check done by a person reading a number in a chain of commands: the day the number is not what it was every other day, the chain goes on
prevention: built: `/Volumes/Projects/blaze-proofs-1113-notes/landmerge.sh <landing worktree> <pr> <quote>` refuses, merging nothing, when origin/main holds a commit the landing branch lacks or the quote is of another tree, and after the merge says whether main`s tree is the smoked one (exit 2 if not). The window between its fetch and GitHub`s merge is seconds, not minutes; closing it needs a merge queue or a required check on the merge commit, which is the repository`s to add.
workaround: smoke main`s exact tree at once after such a merge
